### [Quoting Claude Opus 5 system prompt](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/9/claude-opus-5-system-prompt/#atom-everything)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-09

Anthropic added text to the Claude Opus 5 system prompt to inform the model about the temporary U.S. export control suspension of Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5.

- Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 were released on June 9, 2026, suspended under U.S. Department of Commerce export controls on June 12, and restored on July 1 after controls were lifted on June 30.
- Because the events occurred after the model's training data cutoff, the system prompt explicitly provides these facts to prevent incorrect denials or hallucinated answers.
- The prompt instructs Claude to handle the topic neutrally without personal opinions, refer users to Anthropic's official statement, and search for newer information if capable.

**Why it matters:** System prompts are actively used to inject post-cutoff factual updates and enforce neutral messaging around sensitive regulatory actions without requiring full model retraining.

`system-prompts` `anthropic` `claude` `export-controls` `llms`

### [GitHub Models is now retired](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/9/github-models-is-now-retired/#atom-everything)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-09

GitHub has officially retired GitHub Models, shutting down its unified LLM API and playground service.

- GitHub Models previously provided a unified API across multiple LLM providers and allowed GitHub Actions workflows to authenticate using the environment's default GitHub API key.
- The service enabled continuous AI workflows, such as automatically generating repository folder summaries for README files.
- The author mitigated the retirement by replacing the GitHub API integration with an OpenAI API key using a monthly spending limit to run GPT-5.6 Luna.

**Why it matters:** Workflows reliant on GitHub Models for free or integrated LLM access in GitHub Actions must transition to direct API keys from external model providers.

`github` `github-actions` `llms` `generative-ai`
